Container.Name: clacknotes
Container.Overview: Clack Notes: a retro, typewriter-inspired notes app. Markdown notes with tags, checklists, sharing between users and live sync, stored in SQLite.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI. The app listens on 8000 inside the container.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds the SQLite database (notes.sqlite3). Prefer a cache-pool path (/mnt/cache/...) over /mnt/user/...: SQLite locking is slow on the /mnt/user layer. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Every hostname or IP you open Clack Notes with, comma separated, no scheme or port, e.g. notes.example.com,192.168.1.10,tower. Requests with any other Host header are rejected.

Config.Name: TOTP issuer
Config.Description: Name shown in authenticator apps for two-factor sign-in.

Config.Name: Sign-in attempts
Config.Description: Failed sign-in attempts allowed per window before further attempts are refused.

Config.Name: Sign-in window (seconds)
Config.Description: Length of the sign-in rate-limit window, in seconds.
